slides.headline: 1) PLAN YOUR NEXT 90 DAYS IN 4 MINUTES

slides.headline: 2) CATCH WHAT'S QUIETLY DRAINING YOUR BUSINESS
slides.body: Client churn costs 5 times more to replace than to retain. Paste your monthly numbers, this prompt finds the warning sign before the client walks.

slides.headline: 8 HOURS. ONE PROMPT.
slides.body: Business owners spend 8 to 12 hours a week on tasks that don't grow the business. This prompt finds yours.

slides.headline: 4) BUILD THE RULEBOOK YOUR BUSINESS RUNS ON WITHOUT YOU
slides.body: A consultant charges $300 an hour to write decision frameworks. When you leave, your team makes the wrong call anyway. This prompt writes your full rulebook in 10 minutes.

slides.headline: 5) FIND THE ONE NUMBER THAT RUNS YOUR BUSINESS
slides.body: Most business owners track 5 to 10 metrics and move none of them. This prompt finds the one that, if it moves, guarantees everything else follows.

caption:
Swipe through all 5. These prompts give your business a plan, a sensor check, a task handoff, a rulebook, and the one number that runs everything. 📋

Slide 1 builds a 90-day sprint plan from three goals and one obstacle, the same work a $2,500-a-day business consultant does. Slide 2 runs a monthly health check from your own numbers, flagging the metric bleeding you quietly. Slide 3 finds the single task eating most of your week and gives three ways to hand it off. Slide 4 writes the decision rulebook your team follows when you're not in the room. Slide 5 finds the one number that, if it moves, guarantees your six-month goal gets hit.

Cybercabs are now driving people around Austin with no one at the wheel. The same shift is available to every business right now. The owners who set these five systems up stop reacting and start building.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Tesla, Anthropic

hook_tournament.why: $2,500-A-DAY is a shocking, specific number that makes you stop cold — you know exactly what's promised and why it matters. [2] feels emotionally clever but hides what actually happens, so it's a weaker hook for a stranger.

hook_sharpen.why: The $2,500 day rate in [1] is specific enough to verify, making you swipe to check it. [2] is more shocking but sounds too good to be true without hard numbers backing it up.
